description: Running EC2 instance role has broad S3 read Allow statement
rationale: An IAM role associated through the instance profile of a running EC2 instance contains an unconditional Allow of broad s3:Get*/s3:List* (or s3:* / *) on wildcard S3 resources. This is a policy grant candidate; effective access may be reduced by SCPs, permission boundaries, session constraints, explicit Deny and bucket/KMS policies.
remediation: Scope S3 actions and resources to the minimum required buckets and object prefixes; independently evaluate effective permissions and cross-account resource policies.
